family_reports.body: “This system tore our family apart, stripped away our stability, and left us living…
Torn apart a mom from her kids and alienated a mom for 4+ years…
It cost me my entire life. Caused my kids to have ptsd and trust…
by ignoring evidence, they allowed my child to be molested again.
This system allows legal kidnapping, because there are no checks and balances for Juvenile…
I lost everything fighting for my son, I had my rights taken from me…

public_comments.comment_text: She never once spoke to me. I was never given due process nor aware of my first court date the day they where removed. Wasn't till after the court date susan from cps told me I had a chance to speak and wasn't there. They fumbled bad with my case. And still to this date the man that rapped my daughter walks free. Never once questioned or brought in. Because she was 16 just turned 16 they said it was…
